Name: (CP) More Pets
Author: Whited117
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/v8TEQqH.png[/img][/center]

[center][b][color=#f1c232]More Pets[/color] expands your farm life by introducing a collection of exotic companions that go beyond the traditional cat and dog. From mysterious forest spirits to adorable exotic animals, these new pets bring personality and charm to your valley!

[/b][/center]
[center][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/rXnBTV8.png[/img]
[/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#f1c232]NEW PETS[/color][/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#f1c232]Poro: [/color]Strange ball of fur with horns, somehow resembling a living snowball. Don't let its looks fool you! [/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#f1c232]Baby Goat: [/color] Tiny goat that loves to jump around and headbutt everything in sight. Flamingo Mayonnaise.[/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#f1c232]Junimo: [/color] Mysterious forest spirit that decided your farm is its new home.[/b][/center]
[center][/center]


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/uwXOYhM.png[/img][/center]

[center][b][color=#f1c232]1. Download the mod,
2. unzip
3. copy files
4. paste all files into mod folder[/color][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/sUYczpk.png[/img]
[/center]
[center][color=#f1c232][b]Game Version:[/b] [/color]Fully compatible with [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b].[/center]
[center][b][color=#f1c232]SMAPI:[/color] Requires the latest version of SMAPI installed.[/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#f1c232]Mobile:[/color] This mod may work on Android [color=#ff0000](No tested)[/color][/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#f1c232]Multiplayer:[/color] Works correctly in co-op mode (all players have the mod installed).[/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#f1c232]Bugs:[/color] If you find a bug, Let me know.[/b][/center]
[center][/center]
